reviews.t: Activate before applying prosthetic or piece!!
reviews.x: The adhesive and remover worked perfectly fine for my needs! After reading some of the reviews, I just want to inform everyone that you need to "activate" the adhesive before applying your piece. You activate by placing the adhesive wherever you want and lightly tap it with your finger until it starts to become tacky (it took about 30-45 seconds) with this brand. Afterwards, apply your piece and it should stay perfectly fine. Do not apply this to your piece and then your face...it usuall

I tested this product by attaching a metal pocket watch to my hand and let me tell you, it's been on for two hours so far! When using this stuff, you really have to make sure you tap the spirit gum until it's tacky. If you don't do this, it won't stick to your skin. The more you tap, the tackier it'll get, and the better it'll adhere to your skin.

I used this product yesterday for my Halloween costume. The adhesive worked fine, but the remover caused a serious chemical burn. I had used the fake blood independently and had no reaction, but the whole area where the blood mixed with the remover caused a serious reaction (the blood was Kangaroo brand as well) The first photo is the prosthetic, the second is immediately after using the remover and the last is the next day. I don't know if this was a freak incident, but I would use serious prec

reviews.t: How much can you really like spirit gum :-)
reviews.x: How much can you really like spirit gum?  This worked well.  Brush it on your skin and let it dry a bit (best is 3 to 5 minutes), tap it with your finger to make sure it's really tacky then apply whatever you want.  The remover worked very well...as well as any remover I've used in the past.  I would buy this set again.

I am unsure how this particular spirit gum has positive reviews, other than maybe some packages are a different formula or something?  Note that I have used spirit gum many times in the past and am familiar with how it works. This particular bottle, NEVER dries completely. It didn’t hold my prosthetics in place, as it never dried! All it succeeds in doing is getting everything sticky. The few bits that did actually dry— though wouldn’t even hold a STRING in place, we’re a nightmare to remove, ev

I waited til I knew this stuff would last all night to write this. I'm a dancer and wore elf ears and I sweat at work so I wasn't sure it would stay. They didn't come off at all . I did reapply when I saw a small area come a little loose, but that's nothing. They stayed really well.

I purchased this for my husband to affix a leather half-mask to his face for a masquerade ball. He has worn the mask a few times before to masquerade balls, and we have never had a problem using other brands of spirit gum.  The Kangaroo Spirit Gum, however, is barely sticky.  We ended up using almost the entire bottle of spirit gum to try and make the mask stick; nonetheless, it was falling off his face most of the evening.  He did not need the solvent at all to remove the gum at all, except for

It worked great and it was easy to remove. I actually didn't even have to use the remover that it came with. ( This is probably because I had paint on my face already when I applied it) it comes in a fingernail polish looking bottle with a cheap fingernail polish brush that you would use we're get in a child set. Fingernail polish bottle is the size of a normal bottle. ( I just used an extra small makeup brush or poured it on to a larger brush so I could get all the areas that I want it quickly)

We used this for a Dimebag Darrel costume for our 11 year old daughter and rock themed 5k. She ran the entire time, was sweating and even threw up after the race and had water trickling down her face.... the beard/goatee we ordered stayed on through ALL OF THIS with this glue. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

The spirit gum held up through an entire LARP event with many battles and even taking a few hits directly to the side of the head. My ears never fell off. Although, once I got home and removed them, the spirit gum remover didn't get rid of ALL of the excess. The backs of my real ears were still slightly sticky even after the remover and a shower. Though that stickiness did wear away over night.

Ok, I'll preface this by saying that I've never used any other product to keep a wig on, but I bought this on a recommendation from someone who wears wigs a lot.  This does not keep a lace front wig attached to my head AT ALL.  It does a very good job of making my real hairs stick to my forehead though.  The glue stayed tacky for a very long time. The first time I used it, I made the mistake of trying to get my wig to stick to it right away, and that just caused it to spread around as the wig mo

Tried to use this for Halloween. I read that "priming" the product would make it work properly. I tapped and tapped and tapped until it got tacky.  Prosthetic would not stick, but oddly enough this spirit gum took tons of remover to get it off my skin. Sticks to your skin, but not to whatever you're trying to stick on.

Great product. Have been wanting to get some for a while. It's really nice to have on deck. It works great. Don't know how long it should take to dry though as I've never used this or similar product. Seemed like it took a while. Glues a flatback gem to my forehead and it kept slipping down and roll a really long time to dry. But it works great with sticking feathers to your face and feel like our a work great for stage makeup prosthetics. I'd buy again

Got these for my daughter to use with elf ear she bought for a costume. This worked very well at keeping the ear securely attached to her ears. The costume was worn during marching band practice during the summer and she had no issues with the coming undone with moderate physical activity (marching, walking, running, dancing) or being hot and sweaty. Will be buying again when we need more!

reviews.t: BELIEVE THE OTHER REVIEWS:  THIS DOES NOT WORK
reviews.x: Does not work at all.  I "tapped" it seemingly forever, and the only thingS I got out of it were sticky fingers and a prosthesis which would not adhere where the Spirit Gum was.  Waste.  I threw it away.

reviews.t: It’s a great produce. The spirit gum needs to be tapped ...
reviews.x: It’s a great produce. The spirit gum needs to be tapped for about 30 seconds to become activated. Remover Is awesome too. Great for the price.
Used to glue mustasche and it worked. The remover worked also.

reviews.t: Then I got home and tried to use the adhesive remover to learn that that crap doesn't work
reviews.x: For about an hour I couldn't get this stuff to stick.  I used tons of it.  After neurotically poking at it during my party the facial hair I was sticking on finally stayed.  Then I got home and tried to use the adhesive remover to learn that that crap doesn't work.  I've applied it twice and washed my face twice with face wash and my face is still super sticky.  So, I guess if you wait like 3 hours for the adhesive to work it works great!

I purchased this to secure my elf ears for the Renaissance Fair.  It did the job.  I put it on the areas I needed to press down, waited until it was tacky, then applied the ears.  I was able to get it off pretty easily with some witch hazel and a little of the remover.  The ears came right off when I gently pulled them up, they didn't hurt too much to take off or anything.

reviews.t: Okay for some plastics not at all for wigs
reviews.x: Used this for a wig adhesive and to get some a plastic shaped gem on my skin for a halloween costume, as far as the plastic gem goes it works great and no problems there and for the part it is absolutely terrible there is still residue on the wig even after going through quite a bit of the remover and unfortunately really irritated the skin right above my hairline.

This was my first time doing prosthetics and it was super easy with this spirit gum. I put them on in the morning and wore them all day at work and then until about 10pm until the last trick or treater came to our door. It holds really well and I didn’t even need to use the remover to get it off. It was a great effect.

I so badly wanted this product to work. I used it to stick on my goatee for Halloween. Sadly it would not stay for longer than 10 minutes. I reapplied multiple times and it did not stick. Also, it made my chin breakout. Disappointed in the money spent on this product.

Worked well. Used it to glue a syringe to my chest for my Mia Wallace post overdose Halloween costume. I did end up having to reapply but it may have been due to the fake blood I squirted all over my chest. Overall, worth the purchase and def made my costume great!

reviews.t: Spirit Gum is like water - doesn't work.
reviews.x: Don't waste your money. I ordered this product to use with a Halloween makeup project. The spirit gum was watery and never got tacky so that I could glue the pieces on to my face. I didn't bother returning it. Just save your money and skip this product.

Works great I had a pretty heavy face piece to put on and it stayed on for 6 hours until I removed it.  You just have to make sure that you let the glue get a little tacky/sticky 1st before you apply it to your skin.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the adhesive works well and holds prosthetics securely through sweat, activity, and long wear when properly applied.
Several reviewers stress that the adhesive must be tapped or primed until tacky before it will stick.
A notable number of reviewers say the product is barely sticky or does not hold prosthetics at all.
Some reviewers report the remover works well, while others say it caused a chemical burn or failed to remove all residue.
